events.observed_signal: The repository Agent Handoff test rejected P52 because a Codex next_action retained human_decision_id KU2D-H-000021.

correction.action: Kept H21 as latest human authority and P52 provenance while clearing the downstream Human Decision pointer from the Codex next_action.

checks: Codex next_action has no downstream record pointer

events.schema_impact: No schema change; the queue now conforms to the existing fail-closed actor linkage.
events.quality_impact: Restores authoritative queue readability without changing acquisition evidence or candidate quality.

learning.reusable_lesson: Standing Human authority belongs in latest/provenance fields; a Codex action must not carry a downstream decision pointer.
learning.future_prevention: Validate the complete coordination bundle immediately after advancing a queue to Codex.

events.observed_signal: After queue linkage was corrected, bundle validation rejected proactive H21 because accepted V51 did not request a Human Decision.

correction.action: Added migration KU2D-M-000003 with exact committed Git-blob pins for V51 and H21 and extended repository fixture expectations for only that pair.

checks: Exact V51 and H21 blob validation
Default proactive Human Decision rejection remains active

events.schema_impact: Uses the existing exact-pinned proactive-human compatibility contract; no general authority rule changed.
events.quality_impact: Preserves genuine Human scope authority while preventing unrelated proactive decisions from becoming executable authority.

learning.reusable_lesson: A proactive continuation can remain auditable only through exact record and blob pins, never a generalized authority relaxation.
learning.future_prevention: When an accepted review is followed by explicit Human continuation, add the exact compatibility proof in the same queue-advance commit.

events.observed_signal: P52 requires schema impact, quality impact and final commit linkage per correction, but the closed v1 schema forbade those fields.

correction.action: Added backward-compatible optional schema properties and a fail-closed validator that requires them for P52 journals and rejects pending commit links at PR/closure.

events.schema_impact: Adds optional properties only, so immutable earlier journals remain compatible; the P52 validator enforces the stronger current contract.
events.quality_impact: Correction evidence now distinguishes schema and quality effects and is traceable to an implementation commit.

learning.reusable_lesson: Prompt-level evidence requirements must be representable in the durable schema before a journal can be finalized honestly.
learning.future_prevention: Compare each new correction-policy field against the active schema before implementation begins.

events.observed_signal: Assistant review found that SELF_TEST_CONNECTOR_KIT_V1.py passed locally but was not invoked by Data Acquisition Platform CI.

correction.action: Register the Connector Kit deterministic script in the contract-and-foundation CI corpus and verify the updated exact PR head.

events.schema_impact: No runtime schema change; the deterministic CI corpus gains one explicitly registered script.
events.quality_impact: Prevents Connector Kit contracts from becoming locally tested but CI-unenforced.

learning.reusable_lesson: A deterministic script is not authoritative regression coverage until the platform workflow executes it.
learning.future_prevention: Require every new SELF_TEST script to be registered or explicitly classified as non-corpus before PR review.

events.observed_signal: Assistant review found that the Python validator did not validate identifiers or lifecycle timestamps and did not reject unknown top-level or event fields although the JSON Schema closes both objects.

correction.action: Align the pure validator with the JSON Schema for identifiers, timestamps, exact fields and finalized commit linkage, with positive and negative deterministic cases.

events.schema_impact: No intended document-shape expansion; runtime validation becomes congruent with the closed v1 JSON Schema.
events.quality_impact: Prevents malformed or ambiguous correction evidence from being accepted by the Python path.

learning.reusable_lesson: A closed JSON Schema and its pure runtime validator must reject the same missing and unknown fields.
learning.future_prevention: Add bidirectional schema-parity negatives whenever a closed evidence schema gains a validator.

events.observed_signal: P52 required correction after committed R52, while the protocol allowed only one Result per Prompt and rewriting R52 would violate append-only history.

correction.action: Added a correction_required queue state and explicit Result supersession chain requiring one matching non-Human Assistant correction review; serialized V52 without rewriting R52.

checks: Unlinked and already-reviewed resubmissions fail closed

events.schema_impact: Adds correction_required to queue state and optional supersedes_result_id to later Results; existing records remain valid and unchanged.
events.quality_impact: Preserves review history and prevents a corrected Result from silently replacing prior evidence.

learning.reusable_lesson: Append-only coordination needs an explicit reviewed-Result supersession chain for in-Prompt corrections.
learning.future_prevention: Serialize correction reviews before implementation and resubmit with a new Result ID that pins the reviewed predecessor.
